content: Give a warm hearth and dry clothes to the weary traveler; winter is cold for everyone.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Elds er þörf, þeims inn er kominn (Hávamál, Stanza 3) — Poetic Edda
explanation: In northern lands, refusing warmth or food to a traveler was considered the ultimate moral crime. Life in mortal flesh is cold and demanding for every human soul. When someone arrives weary and frozen, do not interrogate their pedigree; build up the fire and hand them a warm cup.
practicalInsight: Show hospitality to someone who is having a rough day today. Provide a warm word, a coffee, or a listening ear.
reflectionPrompt: How can you be a 'warm hearth' for those who are struggling through their own personal winter?
